findings.claim: For API calls, the current record directs clients through typed oRPC v2 commands/queries on /api/v1, prohibits new imports from the frozen pre-v1 @repo/core/api/* surface, and freezes new direct database, RPC, and realtime call sites until the v1 API covers them.

A shared field belongs in the owned UI kit for both platforms: @repo/ui/components/web for DOM and @repo/ui/components/native for RN, with the same props. Its styling should use world recipes; web CSS modules handle layout and var(--w-*) colors.

The older workflow's tRPC/Supabase/Zustand stack and prescribed palette and animation rules are inconsistent with the current API, UI-kit, and world-recipe guidance and should be reconsidered before implementation.

The older workflow requires user approval of a pre-compilation plan before implementation, while the current supplied rules prescribe exploration, a minimal additive seam, then implementation and verification, without that blanket approval gate. This process requirement should be reconsidered against current project policy.
